title: Maravillosa SEVILLA
text: Super RECOMMENDED. Excellent attention and explanation of the tour.  It also supports you with doubts and useful advice on your visit. We are very grateful to Santiago
author: oca11ros

title: Highlights of our visit to Seville!
text: Santiago is an excellent Guide! He shared with us a lot of historical information and super interesting and the Real Alcazar is awesome!
author: 488giovannab

title: A very enjoyable and enriching visit
text: We visit the Alcázar guided by Santiago. The visit was great and we really liked the Alcázar, but the explanations and all the contributions of Santiago made it even better. We learned many things and would repeat another guided tour with him. Very friendly and attentive.
author: albavilli

title: I highly recommend this Guide (Santiago) for Real Alcázar de Sevilla.
text: We take our hats off to his grace when explaining historical facts. You can see his condescension (in the good sense of the word) and desire to explain what was stated during the journey. Simplifying, he explains in a very pleasant way the different historical facts that originate the structures shown, he is very friendly and explains other historical facts (of Seville) that he has no need to explain and which make the journey very entertaining.   I highly recommend this Guide (Santiago) for Real Alcázar de Sevilla.
author: Departure56962844985

title: Excellent Pro
text: Very complete and didactic the Guide, answered our doubts with great interest and was very attentive to our trip providing suggestions for the coming days
author: Fernando P

title: Review Alcazar
text: I liked the Santiago Guide. He has been very friendly, very friendly and has been very Pro in his Explanatory Guide to the history of the Alcazar cin much detail. An experience to repeat again.
author: Angela7203

title: Review Alcazar, Seville.
text: We loved the Guide, the good treatment and everything he conveyed to us. So far, we have been delighted by everything you have provided. People like the Santiago Tourist Guide provided us from the beginning, the attention of a good Tourist Guide to take as a memory and local culture all those who pass through their hands. We actually give you a 10. And delighted to have found you.
author: fjrogr

title: UNIQUE EXPERIENCE
text: Guide's directions were enjoyable and precise. We were very lucky to find him, because we did not know how to get a visit to the Alcázar and he helped us from the beginning, as well as advising us on places to eat or to buy souvenirs
author: jorgemanuelr397

title: The close and at the same time Pro treatment of the Guide who was attentive to the needs of the group at all times.
text: Fully recommended, Santiago our Guide was attentive at all times of the family and was very friendly and affectionate with the children. Also, after the tour he had a good time answering questions from some people very interested in the history of the place.
author: Bmanchon
